items.title: US demands up to $20,000 visa bond from 50 countries; India left out
items.summary: The United States has introduced a visa bond requirement of up to twenty thousand dollars for citizens of fifty countries. Indian nationals are not included in this list and are therefore exempt from the new bond requirement.
